mechanism: Topiramate may enhance the systemic beta-blocking effects of timolol through additive CNS depression and potential effects on cardiac conduction; topiramate can also cause metabolic acidosis which may affect cardiovascular stability.
action: Monitor for excessive beta-blockade symptoms (bradycardia, hypotension, fatigue, dizziness); ensure adequate ophthalmic dosing technique to minimize systemic absorption; counsel patient on signs of CNS depression.
